headline: A B Cotspin India changes name and NSE symbol to ABC Industries and ABCIND
hook: New ticker and name from November
summary: A B Cotspin India Limited is officially changing its corporate name to ABC Industries India Limited. Along with the name change, its trading symbol on the National Stock Exchange will shift from ABCOTS to ABCIND. The changes take effect from November 02, 2026. Existing shareholders will trade under the new identity going forward.
whats_next: Symbol and name change effective on November 02, 2026
why_it_matters: Search for the stock under its new ticker ABCIND from November.
